html:
Tam Coc tourism in the ripe rice season is most beautiful in the summer, at this time you can take a boat along the Ngo Dong River to admire the scenery surrounded by undulating rocky mountains, below is the clear blue water, on both sides are fragrant rice fields. Besides that, you can also visit the famous sights…

Tam Coc – Bich Dong is one of the famous scenic spots in Ninh Binh, each season here brings visitors a different beauty, but the most beautiful is the golden ripe rice season that looks like a long carpet from afar.

The most beautiful time to travel to Tam Coc in the ripe rice season is from May to June of the solar calendar, at this time the weather is clear, plus the beauty of the ripe rice color adds to the peaceful countryside picture, and is also the time to attract tourists from all over to Ninh Binh.

Coming to Ninh Binh tourism, visitors can also experience on boats, on both sides are brilliant golden rice fields, visitors can freely admire and record for themselves beautiful pictures.

Visitors go on boats to explore the beauty of Tam Coc surrounded by towering limestone mountains, below is a cool blue stream and mysterious caves, a natural beauty that cannot be found anywhere else.

When sailing on the Ngo Dong River to admire the vast scenery, continue the journey, visitors should visit Bich Dong Pagoda with its ancient design

If traveling to Tam Coc, visitors should go early in the morning to admire the sunrise, in the cool weather, the gentle sunlight exudes a unique beauty in Tam Coc.

It can be said that traveling to Tam Coc in any season of the year, whether you sail or walk on the shore, all bring a peaceful scene, a beautiful picture of the countryside, especially in the ripe rice season, looking from afar like a long carpet, at this time Tam Coc seems to put on a passionate cloak, a beautiful picture of the countryside that cannot be found anywhere else.

Tam Coc has its own beauty in each season, but in the summer, Tam Coc wears a unique beauty, a golden color of ripe rice fields stretching out, you can take a boat along the Parasol River to admire the scenery, under the sunlight of the summer, Tam Coc seems to shine, bringing a unique beauty among the mountains and rivers that look like a multi-colored painting.

Tam Coc includes 3 caves: Hang Ca, Hang Hai and Hang Ba on the gentle Ngo Dong River, you can sit on the boats along the river surrounded by high, steep rocky mountains creating a watercolor painting that nature has bestowed on Ninh Binh.

In the summer, Tam Coc stretches out in a golden color, the most beautiful is when sitting on the boats with the locals, you can admire the scenery, and listen to the thrilling stories that will bring you the most unforgettable vacation.

The image of the Ngo Dong River stretching like silk, and adding to it are the fragrant rice flowers in the wind, a rustic and peaceful countryside picture but containing many interesting things.

Places to visit in Tam Coc

Tam Coc – Thai Vi Temple – Thien Huong Cave is a journey chosen by many tourists when coming to Ninh Binh.

  • The destination you cannot miss when traveling to Tam Coc is Hang Ca, 127 m long, coming here you will see the stalactites hanging down like a beautiful picture, the climate is cool all year round, it is the most beautiful destination in the summer in Ninh Binh.
  • Hang Hai when entering the cave you can see the stalactites from the ceiling of the cave looking like the shape of strange animals.
  • Hang Ba is about 50m long, on the ceiling of the cave is a beautiful arched stone arch.
  • Thai Vi Temple is the place to worship Kings Tran Thai Tong, Tran Thanh Tong, Generals Tran Hung Dao, Tran Quang Khai and Queen Tran Thi Dung.
  • Thien Huong Cave is one of the dry caves, located halfway up the mountain facing the poetic river.

Bich Dong Pagoda is one of the ancient pagodas, located majestically on the rocky mountain, in the pagoda there is a large bell cast from the Le Dynasty, the pagoda has been restored and expanded to include Ha Pagoda, Trung Pagoda, Thuong Pagoda, spread over three mountain floors.

To admire the beauty of Tam Coc, take a boat on the Ngo Dong River, you only need 2 hours to admire the beauty here, the beautiful scenery changes with the color of the rice.
